reason: A DeepSeek Harness provider integration that enables GPT model access through ChatGPT OAuth and the local Codex app-server, with installation, profile registration, and credential lifecycle commands.

summaries.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 和本地 Codex app-server，将 GPT 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。
summaries.en: Connects GPT models to DeepSeek Harness through ChatGPT OAuth and the local Codex app-server.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to GPT models through a local Codex app-server
Stores and refreshes delegated login credentials through Codex
Registers, updates, and removes the plugin across Harness profiles
Can purge stored Codex authentication data during uninstall
